# Notification Management

In-app notifications — count, list, skip.

3 operation(s). Base URL `https://vannbros-qa.burqio.site`; `{version}` in a path is `1`. Calls need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (see ../SKILL.md). **Read-only for QA:** only GETs, and not the GETs SKILL.md lists as side-effecting.

<a id="op-notification-getnotificationcount"></a>
### GET `/api/v{version}/Notification/GetNotificationCount`

operationId `Notification_GetNotificationCount` · Retrieves the count of unread notifications for the current user or system

| Param | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ServiceIds` | query | int64[] |  | array: repeat the key (`?K=1&K=2`) |
| `IsSkipped` | query | boolean |  |  |
| `IsSent` | query | boolean |  |  |
| `version` | path | string | yes |  |

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfNotificationCountResponse](#schema-resultofnotificationcountresponse) | Notification count retrieved successfully |
| `400` | [Result](#schema-result) | Invalid query parameters |
| `500` | [Result](#schema-result) | Internal server error |

| `version` | path | string | yes |  |

Request body: _none_

<a id="op-notification-getnotifications"></a>
### GET `/api/v{version}/Notification/GetNotifications`

operationId `Notification_GetNotifications` · Retrieves a paginated list of notifications with optional filtering

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PageNumber` | query | int32 |  | non-nullable (omitted → server default, e.g. 0/false) |

| `FromDate` | query | string (date-time) |  |  |

| `SortBy` | query | string |  |  |
| `SortDescending` | query | boolean |  | non-nullable (omitted → server default, e.g. 0/false) |
| `IsSent` | query | boolean |  |  |
| `SearchKeyword` | query | string |  | Free-text keywords matched across the notification's subject, body, exception, service name, message id and software code. Null or blank returns everything. |
| `version` | path | string | yes |  |
